description: Generate scene variants for a model image using either a scene reference image or a text scene prompt.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the model image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: sceneImgUrl
fields.description: Optional public URL of the target scene reference.

fields.name: scenePrompt
fields.description: Optional text prompt describing the target scene.

fields.name: sceneStrength
fields.description: Scene reference strength from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.7.

fields.name: genOriRes
fields.description: Whether to generate the original resolution. Defaults to false.

fields.name: realModel
fields.description: Whether to prefer realistic model rendering.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.
